purpose: Freeze execution/metric semantics left implicit by preregistration before any IPS-filter PnL is computed.

indicator_event_rule.risk_filter: NONE; all causally valid frozen IPS events qualify regardless of experimental outcome-contract risk_cents

base_trade_rule.entry_timestamp: first executable tick timestamp of the already-frozen M1 entry bar
base_trade_rule.R: unchanged M1 frozen trade R including its 0.02R central cost

metric_definitions.PF: sum(R>0) / abs(sum(R<0)); +inf if no negative trades
metric_definitions.max_DD_R: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of chronological cumulative filtered R
metric_definitions.positive_years_fraction: among calendar years containing >=1 filtered trade, fraction with yearly net R > 0
metric_definitions.top_3_filtered_trades_net_share: if filtered total net R > 0: sum of the three largest trade R values divided by filtered total net R; if <=0 the total-R hard gate already fails and concentration gate is treated as failed/undefined
metric_definitions.2023_2024_expectancy: mean R in the year if >=1 filtered trade

multiplicity: N_TESTS remains 1; no alternate window, threshold, base alpha, exit, or risk rule will be evaluated under this identity.
